items.title: Poems, by That most Famous Wit, William Drummond of Hawthornden.
items.description: William Drummond (1585-1649) was a Scottish poet, born at Hawthornden Castle, Midlothian. He was influenced more greatly by English and Italian poets than by any characteristically Scottish writing and he was sometimes referred to as "the Scottish Petrarch". This book has been severely trimmed, with loss of text from the bottom of the pages.
